subject: Intermittent portal session resets blocking ProcureCo vendor sign-up
messages:
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@procureco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureCo Onboarding <onboard@procureco.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble completing vendor registration (keeps logging out)

Hi Jordan / Ben,

We're trying to finish the vendor setup for two suppliers and every time the user completes the email verification step the portal drops them back to the login screen. They see a brief 302 and then an empty cart of fields. I've attached a screenshot (coupa-screenshot-404.png) and the vendor W-9 for the one that failed (procureco-w9.pdf).

Steps we took:
- Clicked verification link from email
- Entered tax and banking info
- Clicked Submit -> redirected to login

Can you advise quickly? We're on a tight cutover with ProcureCo accounting next week.

Thanks,
Lisa Grant
Vendor Ops Manager
ProcureCo Inc.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@procureco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble completing vendor registration (keeps logging out)

Thanks for the details and attachments, Lisa — sorry you're running into this. We're looking into it now. Quick ask so we can reproduce: can you send one timestamp (approx) when the failure happened and the browser (Chrome/Edge/Safari) + OS? If you can try an incognito window and report whether the behavior is the same that will help us rule out an extension/cache issue.

Ben / Monica: assigning to you to check session cookie TTLs and any proxy/redirect rules in the Coupa flow. Ben, if you spot 302->/login sequences in the logs please paste a short snippet. Monica, can you check whether our verification link includes a redirect param that might be getting stripped by a downstream gateway?

I'll follow up to ProcureCo once we have a likely cause.

—Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:27:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble completing vendor registration (keeps logging out)

Quick log dump from edge-proxy around the time Lisa reported:

[2025-07-19T08:58:43.112Z] request POST /vendor/verify 200 user=procureco-vendor-394 session_id=abc123
[2025-07-19T08:58:43.128Z] response 302 Location=/login set-cookie="session=; Path=/; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT"
[2025-07-19T08:58:43.129Z] cookie cleared for user procureco-vendor-394

That set-cookie with an expired date looks like an upstream component is clearing our session right after verification. I don't see a direct Coupa error — more likely a proxy or SSO handoff issue. Monica, I suspect the redirect back to /vendor/dashboard is triggering a path mismatch in the cookie domain or SameSite attribute.

I'll open a ticket with infra if we can't find the rule quickly.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@procureco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble completing vendor registration (keeps logging out)

Hi Lisa — update from our side and a small ask:

What we found: Ben's logs show the session cookie is being cleared immediately after the verification POST, which is consistent with an intermediate gateway returning a Set-Cookie with an expired timestamp. Monica suspects a SameSite=None vs SameSite=Lax mismatch on the vendor redirect. We've opened a short infra investigation to look at proxy rewrite rules.

Can you try the following and let us know results?
1) Attempt the registration in an incognito/private window (no extensions)
2) If it fails, take the timestamp and browser devtools network trace (just the request/response headers will do) and send to us

Temporary workaround: if ProcureCo can provide a single-use direct sign-up link (no redirect through the partner portal) it should let the user finish while we remediate. I've attached a lightweight checklist for your onboarding team: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aProcureCoOnboardChecklist

We'll keep you posted — aiming to have a permanent fix by end of this week.

Best,
Jordan

From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@procureco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureCo Onboarding <onboard@procureco.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble completing vendor registration (keeps logging out)

Jordan / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. I tried an incognito window and was able to finish the registration for one vendor (timestamp 2025-07-21T16:32:18-07:00). That suggests it is an extension/cache/session problem for our regular browser. We can use the single-use link for the rest of the batch while you patch.

Request: please keep us posted on the permanent fix and once resolved let's schedule a 15-min sync so our onboarding team can close their checklist.

Attaching the W-9 and the screenshot again for completeness.

Regards,
Lisa
